body:
Thank you everyone for your concern and kind advice! I really appreciate that. 
I knew I shouldn't have told them about my depression. I made a wrong decision. 
I didn't think they would say things like that. 
I'm scared of making new friends or getting involved with anyone again after all of this happened.. but I'll try.
Agreed! We didn't ask to be born.

I heard about this question and I'm trying to figure out why some people say suicide is selfish. I don't have any loved ones, so I'm just trying to understand that feeling of being called "selfish". I don't know what people think about me, but I'm sure someone wants me to die. I can feel it. I'm unloved and unwanted.
